description:
From: Elixir Parity. User-approved 2026-11-25. Not on #791's current path. A correctness bug.
Minimal repro (Elixir Parity's scratchpad walk791/p1.fz): for v <- [1,2] do try do if v == 1, do: v, else: raise("x") catch k, r -> {k, r} end end. interp reports "missed an exhaustive dispatch", and native gets SIGILL. It works inside a named function.
Done when: the repro matches Elixir on all three paths, as an oracle fixture.
title: try … catch k, r over a union value whose arm raises dispatches the catch
